items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I said, “I’ve got something in mind,” and I brought him this and he says, “It’s very interesting, how could we use it?” ... and then he starts coming up with – then his fertile brain starts taking hold and he starts coming up with the camp announcements

ctx.x: I was going to use the word, “sober,” to describe him as opposed to Michel’s which is as you call it, “flashy.”
Michel is very flamboyant, Bob is not flamboyant or flashy, but it’s so rich and it’s, I don’t know how to describe it, it’s very sensuous the way he writes.
And his uses of woodwinds of course.
